Approaching an owner who is not selling

Response rate on a letter campaign runs a few percent. Twenty letters is a realistic week.

01

Write, do not call

A plainly typed letter to the mailing address. No logo, no brochure. A cold call about someone's land reads as a scam, and Michigan's telephone solicitation rules are worth staying clear of.

02

Say who is buying and why

A friend looking for a few acres to build one house on. Not a developer. Name the parcel by its address so they know you did the work.

03

Do not open with a number

The estimate is twice the state equalized value, which is Michigan's legal definition of market value and a reasonable opening guess. It is not an appraisal. Ask what they would want.

04

Leave the door open

If the timing is wrong now, say you will check back in a year. A good share of these sales happen on the second contact, not the first.

A letter that gets answered
Dear [owner],

I am writing about your vacant parcel at [address] in [township],
Leelanau County (parcel [id]).

A close friend of mine is looking for a few acres near Traverse City
to build a single home on, and yours is one of a small number that
fits what he needs. I found you through the county tax roll, so I
apologise if this is unwelcome - if so, throw this away and you will
not hear from me again.

If you have ever thought about selling, I would like to talk. He is
buying for himself, not for development, and he can move quickly.
If the timing is wrong now but might be right later, I am happy to
leave it there and check back in a year.

Either way, thank you for reading.

[name]
[phone] / [email]

Known gap

Grand Traverse County has no off-market coverage

Their GIS server accepts the connection then resets the handshake — retried from two different clients, same result. Old Mission, East Bay, Long Lake, Blair, Green Lake, Acme and Whitewater are all missing from the off-market list. The Equalization department can hand over the parcel file directly.

What the numbers mean

DRIVE

Routed, not guessed

Every minute figure is a real driving route from the parcel to Front and Union. Treat 28 to 32 minutes as a coin flip — season and the US-31 bottleneck both move it.

ROAD

Two sources, then eyes

Road names checked against the OpenStreetMap surface database, then the shortlist confirmed on satellite imagery at street-level zoom. Unverified means no surface data exists — ask the agent.

TYPE

Corrected against the record

Five listings sold as houses are manufactured homes and are tagged as such. Two more were filed as houses with no bedrooms and no living area — they are vacant land, and one of them then failed the land budget and came out.

VALUE

SEV doubled

Off-market estimates are twice the state equalized value. Michigan sets SEV at half of true cash value, so this is a fair opening guess and nothing more. A suspiciously low one usually means wetland.
